action-failed: That did not go through. Try again, or use the buttons in Discord.
alarms-none: No alarms in the last 14 days.
alarms-none-resolved: Nothing resolved in the last 14 days.
chart-empty: Not enough data in this range yet. A point is recorded every minute.
chart-empty-2: No data for this metric yet. It appears a few minutes after the metric first sees traffic.
chart-label: {{title}}, latest {{value}}. Use the arrow keys to read earlier points.
confirm-escalate-body: This pages everyone, clears any acknowledgement and keeps paging until someone takes it.
confirm-resolve-body: It closes the alert in Discord. If the check is still failing, the alarm fires again on its next run.
hb-last: Last {{when}} · pages after {{limit}} min of silence
hb-never: No check-in yet — not watched until the first one.
heartbeats-body: Senders on the VPS check in with the watchdog; silence past the limit pages.
link-description: What is paging right now, who acknowledged it, and whether every sender is checking in.
metrics-body: Response times, page loads and LLM calls, with each alarm’s threshold as a dashed line.
metrics-failed: Could not load the metrics. Refresh to try again.
not-configured-body: Set ONCALL_URL and ONCALL_SIGNING_SECRET in .env.production and restart web. Paging itself does not depend on this page.
rem-deploy-body: Starts the deploy workflow on main again. It builds, tests and ships the latest commit, so a fix pushed since the failure goes out with it.
rem-jobs-body: Retries the newest failed jobs, up to 100 per queue, in every queue that has failures.
rem-outbox-body: Gives every dead outbox event another round of delivery attempts. Delivered events are not touched.
rule-save-failed: Could not save the alarm rule. Try again.
rules-body: Thresholds over the one-minute metrics history. Defaults live in lib/ops/alarm-rules.ts; a change here overrides the code until you reset it.
rules-failed: Could not load the alarm rules. Refresh to try again.
unreachable-body: The watchdog did not answer. Paging runs on the watchdog itself, so alerts still reach #rmh-oncall — check there.
